abstract: BACKGROUND: Paraneoplastic syndromes often cause endocrine, neurological, cutaneous, and hematologic pathologies, and cases with digestive symptoms as prominent cases are rare. CASE DESCRIPTION: A 1-year-old child admitted to the emergency department with severe abdominal distension was later diagnosed with sacrococcygeal yolk cystoma with ulcerative colitis. After symptomatic management, surgical removal of the tumor, and JEB chemotherapy, the symptoms of ulcerative colitis disappeared completely. After 7 years of follow-up, the child grew and developed well, and there was no recurrence of tumor and ulcerative colitis. CONCLUSION: Yolk sac tumor with ulcerative colitis is a rare paraneoplastic syndrome with complex clinical manifestations.
abstract_ja: 背景：傍腫瘍症候群はしばしば内分泌、神経学的、皮膚科的、および血液学的病理を引き起こし消化症状が顕著な症例は稀である。症例記述：緊急科に重度の腹部膨満で入院した1歳の小児はその後後腹膜卵黄嚢腫瘍と潰瘍性大腸炎と診断された。症候的管理、腫瘍の外科的除去、およびJEB化学療法の後潰瘍性大腸炎の症状は完全に消失した。7年のフォローアップの後小児は良好に成長および発達し腫瘍と潰瘍性大腸炎の再発はなかった。結論：潰瘍性大腸炎を伴う卵黄嚢腫瘍は複雑な臨床的あらわれを有する稀な傍腫瘍症候群である。
